selection_rationale: 12mm bumps and 18-22mm low steps are below the adopted policy's roughly 40-60mm swing peaks; 2.5-3deg hills are mild but nonflat. Compound places all three components before x=3.1m.
height_definition: Vertical foot sphere bottom minus native piecewise-planar terrain height at its center XY. Relative base clearance is base z minus terrain height at base XY. Not normal-distance or foot-center slip.
step_representation: Native connected heightfield, 18-22mm rise across one 25mm grid cell; this is a discretized low step, not a vertical wall.
